crossRefs.note: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said…
So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

translations.web: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying, yet he didn’t enter in.
translations.bsb: He bent down and looked in at the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.
translations.kjv: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
translations.asv: and stooping and looking in, he seeth the linen cloths lying; yet entered he not in.
